title: fix: refresh KPI data every 30 minutes
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Reduces the Tinybird edge-cache TTL from 6 hours to 30 minutes
- Keeps the existing lazy refresh behavior
- Leaves frontend loading behavior unchanged

gist.headline: Fresher numbers in the hive
gist.blurb: The KPI garden gets watered every 30 minutes now, instead of waiting half a day. Same lazy refresh, less vintage telemetry.
gist.summary: Reduced the Tinybird KPI worker edge-cache TTL from 6 hours to 30 minutes while retaining lazy refresh and the existing frontend loading behavior.
gist.impact: Dashboard KPI data can now reflect changes within roughly 30 minutes without adding new loading states or changing how the frontend fetches it.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a tiny gardener with a watering can tending a dashboard-shaped garden: a retro CRT shows gently rising KPI charts, while a small pixel clock reads 30 MIN. Freshly watered code-plants and flowers represent more current cached analytics; Polli's gardening accessory makes the refresh cadence clear.
